Flat Normals & Blocky Rendering | Voxel Plugin
Blocky Rendering The plugin has support for basic blocky rendering. To make use of this, tick the Blockiness box on your Voxel World. A mesh stamp with shape disabled and Blockiness metadata assigned, being dragged around a world with Blockiness enabled.
